_comment: ADR-037 register fragment for the version-snapshots change. Adds the disjoint schema key `versionSnapshot`: a named, frozen copy of one ApplicationVersion's manifest. It is NOT an ApplicationVersion row, so ADR-002 (no sibling version rows) holds. Written and read only through VersionSnapshotService, which checks the parent Application's roles; direct REST writes are admin-only.

versionSnapshot.title: Version Snapshot
versionSnapshot.description: A named copy of one ApplicationVersion's manifest at the moment it was taken. Taken by hand (`manual`) or kept automatically when a rollback replaces the manifest (`previous-draft`). Covers the manifest only, never records.

application.title: Application
application.description: The Application the snapshot belongs to.

version.title: Version
version.description: The ApplicationVersion whose manifest was copied.

label.title: Label
label.description: Short name the user gave the snapshot.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.description: The version's manifest as it was when the snapshot was taken.

checksum.title: Checksum
checksum.description: SHA-256 of the canonical manifest, so identical snapshots are easy to spot.

takenBy.title: Taken by
takenBy.description: Nextcloud user id of who took the snapshot.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `manual` when a user took it, `previous-draft` when a rollback kept the state it replaced.
